# DELTA overview {#delta-overview}

The DELTA features of each comparison. A feature is listed when it passes the
filter (m<sub>eff</sub> &gt; `r book$delta$min_m_eff` and `p_perm` &lt; 0.05)
and is among the `r book$delta$top_n` highest phipflow weighted scores of its
rank and direction, or when it is listed under `delta: features` in
`report_config.yml` (marked "manual"). Each feature links to its plots.

- **Feature**: taxon or protein (annotation with the protein ID in brackets).
- **Peptides**: enriched peptides contributing to the statistic.
- **T_obs_stand**: standardized Stouffer statistic of the prevalence shift.
- **p_perm**: raw permutation p-value; bold below 0.01.
- **max_delta**: largest peptide-level prevalence difference.
- **Score**: phipflow's weighted score, |T_obs_stand| × max_delta with each
  scaled to 0-1 within the rank; compare it within a rank only.
- **Direction**: which group has the higher prevalence.

<div class="callout callout-warn">
`p_perm` is **uncorrected**. Every comparison tests thousands of features, so
many will pass a 0.05 threshold by chance alone. The tables are
hypothesis-generating, not a list of established findings.
</div>

```{r, results='asis'}
for (cmp in book$comparisons) {
  n <- delta_counts(cmp)
  cat(cmp_heading(cmp, 2, "delta-summary"))
  if (!is.na(n[["tested"]])) {
    cat(sprintf("%d features tested, %d pass the filter, %d shown (%d added by hand). ",
                n[["tested"]], n[["passing"]], n[["shown"]], n[["manual"]]))
    sig <- file.path(cmp_base(cmp), "DELTA_framework",
                     sprintf("delta_table_m_eff_gt%s_p_perm_lt0.05.csv", book$delta$min_m_eff))
    cat(nox_link(sig, "Download all passing features (CSV)"), "\n\n")
  }
  cat(feature_table(cmp), "\n\n")
}
```
